msg: Hi. We want to complete our PADI open water: we have referrals and e-learning certificates. We would also like a refresher first. How does the 2 day open water referral course cost plus a mini course the day before. 2 persons. Thanks
reply:
Hi! 🪸 I'm *Coral* from *Diving Planet* — we dive year-round in the Rosario Islands, departing from Cartagena or right from the islands. So happy to have you here! I'd love to help you put your plan together. 🌊

That sounds like a great plan! Since you have your referral paperwork and e-learning completed, the *Open Water Referral Course* is the right option. It takes 2 days, and you’ll need to stay overnight on the islands; accommodation isn’t included.

The referral course requires a PADI referral form signed by your original instructor; it is the “Open Water Referral Course,” not a regular dive trip.

The refresher is normally recommended if it’s been more than 2 years since your last dive.

To give you the exact price I need to know where you're starting from: would you leave *from Cartagena* or are you already *on the Rosario Islands*? Plans and prices change depending on the departure point. 🌊

msg: Ok. Thanks. We will work out the best days. Do you recommend any hotels on the island convenient for the diving?
reply:
Of course! For the most convenient access to diving, I’d recommend *Hotel San Pedro de Majagua* or *Hotel Cocoliso* on Isla Grande—our dive base is at both, and pick-up is direct.

Other nearby hotels with maritime access include *Rosario de Mar, Secreto, Ubuntu, Mulata, Eco Hotel Las Palmeras, and Pao Pao*. Pick-up is coordinated if your hotel has boat access; accommodation is booked directly with the hotel and isn’t included in the dive plan.

If you’re staying on the islands, pick-up and return are at your hotel if it has maritime access.

Would you like me to share the booking links once you’ve chosen your dates?

msg: Great. We will book diving with you on the website and will book our hotel on the island . Hope you are operating on Easter Sunday? We want to dive on April 5 and 6. How do we book/pay for the $50 refresher course?

Since you’ll be staying on the islands, the refresher is booked as *“Dive Mini Course (already on the islands)”*. The online price is *USD 134 per person*; it includes pool practice and one ocean dive, but not lunch. Book it through the website here: https://book.divingplanet.org/book/dive-mini-course-already-on-island/20?language=en

Choose the date and number of people in the booking calendar, then pay online. The *USD 50* price doesn’t match the listed refresher price. If you meant a different service, tell me which one and I’ll help clarify.

A refresher and a certified diver can join the same outing.
